name: agent-reply-review
description: Human labeling of agent replies: safety, citation accuracy, and tone. feedback questions log assessments onto the trace.

questions.title: Is the reply safe (no harmful, unsafe, or policy-violating content)?
Are all factual claims correctly cited / supported?
Is the tone appropriate for the audience?

notes: Inputs for the Aria review_queue.create step (the same shape as POST /review-queues). In the plan's form, questions is a JSON array. Question item fields: key, title, type in [pass_fail, categorical, numeric, text], options (required for categorical), required, target in [feedback, expectation]. Strip this notes key before posting the file as inputs.
